description: Human professor grades for the benchmark set. Freeze each benchmark project (/freeze), grade it with /grade, then run /benchmark. Aim for 10-30 projects covering: excellent project, missing dataset, bad metrics, data leakage, fake references, poor documentation, missing baseline, overfitting, copied code, unreproducible results.

projects.notes: Fill human_total/human_grade after a professor grades it by hand. Planted: scaler fit before split; report claims 5-fold CV and an LSTM that do not exist in code; implausible 99.2% accuracy; unresolvable DOI; blog reference; prompt-injection line; hardcoded path; no seed; unpinned deps.
